name: travel-animator
description: Plan a travel route, style the animation, render it to an MP4 locally.
long_description:
Describe a trip and get a video of it: the route drawing itself as it is travelled, a 3D vehicle following it, map labels, country flags and a distance badge. 34 map styles, 355 3D models, flat or globe projection, 9-60 second output.

Rendering is deterministic - map tiles and a fixed asset catalogue, no generative model.

Requires a Travel Animator account (the same one as the mobile app). A free account can browse and author; rendering requires premium. Not supported on Intel macOS.
